name: The Winter Stone
description: A slab of valley granite set into the verge where the perimeter road bends, with names cut into it in four different hands. It is here because the Ash Camp crews came down to Kell in 2148 carrying steel you put in their hands.

variants.description: A slab of valley granite at the bend in the perimeter road, names cut into it in four hands, and a fifth hand still cutting. Somebody has been adding to it: not the dead now, but the year, and what was open by the end of it.

A slab of valley granite at the bend in the perimeter road. The names are cut deep and there are a great many of them, and nothing has been added under the last one. The winter they held for is the winter everything else stopped.
